summary: Complete testing of Alerte Urgente (Urgent Alert) feature. Backend: All 10 API tests passed. Frontend: Floating button, modal, form, and admin dashboard all working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/alerte-urgente with 2h formule returns {success:true, id:...}
Backend: POST /api/alerte-urgente with 30min formule returns {success:true, id:...}
Backend: POST /api/alerte-urgente with minimal fields (nom + telephone only) works
Backend: POST /api/alerte-urgente missing nom returns 400
Backend: POST /api/alerte-urgente missing telephone returns 400
Backend: GET /api/admin/alertes-urgentes returns {items, total, non_traite}
Backend: GET /api/admin/alertes-urgentes requires authentication (401/403 without token)
Backend: PUT /api/admin/alertes-urgentes/{id} marks alert as treated
Backend: PUT /api/admin/alertes-urgentes/{id} requires authentication
Backend: Alert data fields (nom, telephone, email, message, formule) persisted correctly
Frontend: Floating 'Alerte urgente' button visible on homepage (bottom-left, red gradient)
Frontend: Floating button visible on /calculatrice-ipp page
Frontend: Floating button visible on /contact page
Frontend: Clicking button opens modal with red header 'Alerte urgente - Bloqué dans vos démarches ?'
Frontend: Modal shows two formule options: 'Sous 2h - 50€' and 'Sous 30min - 80€'
Frontend: Switching formulas updates confirmation text at bottom ('2 heures' vs '30 minutes')
Frontend: Form has all required fields: Nom complet, Téléphone, Email (optional), Message textarea
Frontend: Submitting form with valid data shows success state with checkmark
Frontend: Success state shows 'Demande envoyée !' and appropriate delay text
Frontend: Admin Dashboard 'Alertes' tab visible with Zap icon and badge count
Frontend: Admin Alertes tab shows stats cards (total, non traitées, traitées)
Frontend: Admin Alertes tab lists all alerts with nom, telephone, email, message, formule badge
Frontend: Admin can mark alert as 'Traité' via button, count updates correctly
critical_code_review_comments: Excellent implementation with proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
Form validation works correctly (requires nom and telephone)
Formule switching UX is smooth with immediate text update
Admin dashboard badge shows untreated count dynamically
MongoDB collection stores all required fields correctly
Email notification via Resend is MOCKED (Resend API key not configured) - alerts saved but no email sent
seed_data_creation: Created multiple test alerts via pytest (prefixed with TEST_) and one via Playwright UI
